source_delta: Shared UI font selection now follows rendering-context locale; drawing and explicit-locale semantics remain scoped as reviewed.

jvm.legacy_limit: API21/24 executions establish legacy font binding, not installed/native glyph geometry.

host_python.skipped_identity_limit: Compact hosted output may not name skipped methods.

delivery.source_apk_fonts_resources_and_applicati: Bound by the current delivery and compiled-result files; old APK bytes receive no current credit.

renders.visual_scope: Prior documented JVM inspection is reused only by exact original PNG equality; current JSON, pixels, controls and identities are freshly checked.
renders.review_required_positive_disposition: fresh-fringe-disposition.json; exact=false/review_required=true retained for the same specific mixed-Arabic low-alpha fringe. No universal tolerance.

remaining_scope_limits: This does not certify linguistic completeness/fluency, Settings UI, physical devices, TalkBack, private upgrade signing or release readiness.
Installed cases do not force every process-default mismatch; those new controls are separately exercised in JVM tests.
Retained oversized-caption evidence proves programmatic offset retention, not simultaneous full-caption visibility or installed reachability.
Existing intermediate-scroll/short-landscape characterization and pre-click dialog-locale limits remain.
The ten preexisting individual font-notice reference metadata gaps remain separate; aggregate notices are retained.
Bulk replay content screening/publication is separate from this frozen functional verdict; no new raw disclosure is approved by this file.
reviewer_actions: Read-only source/artifact analysis and audit-tool checks; no application edits, GitHub writes or new local Android run.
